title: Run Diagnostics (didSave)
summary: Runs drag-lint's diagnostics pass on a file automatically when it is saved, mirroring the LSP textDocument/didSave notification
intro: Read this to know why drag-lint findings refresh on their own: the diagnostics pass runs on a file each time you save it in the IDE, so there is nothing to invoke by hand.

surfaces.caption: Run Diagnostics (didSave)
steps: Nothing to click; it fires each time you save a file in the IDE
It needs an open editor with a saved file
There is no CLI equivalent; it runs in-process in the plugin

questions.ask: Why do drag-lint findings refresh by themselves when I save?
